text: AI is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of the biggest effects is automation, where software takes over repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This saves time and allows people to focus on more creative and complex work. In addition, AI-powered productivity tools, such as smart email assistants and project managers, help teams organize their days better. However, this doesn't mean humans are being replaced. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming the norm — workers guide AI, check its results, and make final decisions. Of course, these changes mean some jobs will evolve or disappear, so learning new skills is essential for staying relevant.
